units.source: Deleted notes are listed in the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Deleted Notes__TRILIUM_PH_1__ dialog (__TRILIUM_PH_2__Global menu__TRILIUM_PH_3__ → __TRILIUM_PH_4__Deleted notes__TRILIUM_PH_5__) and can be restored by pressing the __TRILIUM_PH_6__undelete__TRILIUM_PH_7__ link.

If a note has child notes, they will be restored along with it. Should the original location no longer exist (e.g. the parent has been deleted), the note will be restored into the default location for new notes (__TRILIUM_PH_0__Note Inbox__TRILIUM_PH_1__).
When a note is hoisted in the tree, the dialog will only display notes deleted from the subtree of that hoisted note.
To permanently erase deleted notes and clear the list, press the three-dots menu and select __TRILIUM_PH_0__Erase deleted notes now__TRILIUM_PH_1__.

Deleted notes are permanently erased after a certain amount of time (7 days by default). To change this interval, press the three-dots menu and select __TRILIUM_PH_0__Deleted Notes Settings__TRILIUM_PH_1__.
